description: This file 'UtilValidate.java' provides a comprehensive set of utility methods for validating various types of data inputs, such as strings, numbers, dates, email addresses, URLs, credit card numbers, and other identifiers. It includes logic for format validation as well as specific checks for common data patterns relevant to the OFBiz framework, such as zip codes, social security numbers, state codes, and credit card validation using Luhn algorithm.

classes.name: UtilValidate
classes.description: A utility class offering extensive validation methods for various data types, including strings, numbers, dates, email addresses, URLs, credit cards, and IDs, primarily used within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if an Object, IsEmpty interface, Collection, Map, or CharSequence is empty or null.

methods.name: isNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if an Object, IsEmpty interface, Collection, or CharSequence is not empty or null.

methods.name: isString

methods.name: isWhitespace
methods.description: Determines if a string consists solely of whitespace characters.
